Account access: Open the affected service’s password reset page. If the account stays locked, contact the service desk.
Hardware: Check that the device is connected to power. Contact the service desk if it still will not start or charge.
Network: Check the campus service status page. If there is no reported outage, reconnect to the campus Wi-Fi.
Software: Restart the application. If the issue continues, note the error message and contact the service desk.
